# Overview

Characterize the CDS length, GC content, and GC3 content of mRNAs translationally
promoted by eIF3d in hypoxia (1hr, te_lfc > 0.5, te_padj < 0.05), compared to all
expressed mRNAs and a size-matched negative control set. Transcript selection (most
abundant isoform per gene, MDA-MB-231 siCTRL normoxia) is read directly from the
pre-computed feature matrix. For promoted genes absent from the normoxia feature
matrix, the most abundant isoform from 1hr hypoxia siCTRL samples is used as a
fallback.

Overlaid density plots annotate CDS length, GC%, and GC3% for the Renilla, Firefly,
and NanoLuc luciferase reporters used in the lab. All CDS metrics -- genes and
reporters alike -- are computed on stop-codon-free ORFs; GENCODE txdb CDS ranges
include the terminal stop codon, so it is stripped from the gene sequences before
length/GC/GC3 are computed.

Reporter sequences are the actual lab constructs and are hard-coded here, not
fetched from GenBank: the humanized Renilla construct shares only 71% nucleotide
identity with the native gene (GC3 88% vs 26%), so a database sequence would put
the reference line in entirely the wrong place.

# Load Libraries

```{r load_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(GenomicFeatures)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
library(Biostrings)
```

```{r helper_functions}
codon_split <- function(s) {
  n <- nchar(s) %/% 3L
  substring(s,
            seq.int(1L, by = 3L, length.out = n),
            seq.int(3L, by = 3L, length.out = n))
}

# Validate a reporter ORF: in-frame, ATG start, no internal stop, and already
# stop-codon-free (all reporter sequences are stored without their stop codon
# so they match the stop-stripped gene CDS sequences).
STOP_CODONS <- c("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")

check_orf <- function(s, name) {
  s   <- toupper(gsub("\\s", "", s))
  cdn <- codon_split(s)
  stopifnot(
    "Reporter ORF length not divisible by 3"     = nchar(s) %% 3 == 0,
    "Reporter ORF does not start with ATG"       = cdn[1] == "ATG",
    "Reporter ORF has an internal stop codon"    =
      !any(cdn[-c(1L, length(cdn))] %in% STOP_CODONS),
    "Reporter ORF still carries a terminal stop" =
      !cdn[length(cdn)] %in% STOP_CODONS
  )
  cat(sprintf("  %-8s OK: %d nt, %d codons\n", name, nchar(s), length(cdn)))
  invisible(TRUE)
}

compute_gc3_pct <- function(s) {
  s <- toupper(gsub("\\s", "", s))
  if (is.na(s) || nchar(s) < 3L) return(NA_real_)
  n_codons <- nchar(s) %/% 3L
  starts   <- seq.int(3L, n_codons * 3L, 3L)
  thirds   <- substr(rep.int(s, n_codons), starts, starts)
  sum(thirds %in% c("G", "C")) * 100 / n_codons
}
```

# Load Gene Sets

```{r load_promotes}
te_hyp <- read_csv(here("output", "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv"),
                   show_col_types = FALSE)

promotes <- te_hyp %>%
  filter(te_lfc > 0.5, te_padj < 0.05) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

stopifnot("Expected 1604 eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes" = nrow(promotes) == 1604)
cat("eIF3d hypoxia-promoted genes (te_lfc > 0.5, te_padj < 0.05):", nrow(promotes), "\n")
```

# Get Transcript IDs from Feature Matrix

```{r load_feature_matrix}
fm <- readRDS(here("output", "predictive_modeling", "feature_matrix_external_stability.rds"))

tx_all <- fm %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

tx_promotes <- tx_all %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% promotes$gene_id_clean)

cat("All expressed genes in feature matrix:", nrow(tx_all), "\n")
cat("Promoted genes found in feature matrix:", nrow(tx_promotes), "of", nrow(promotes), "\n")
```

# Hypoxia Fallback for Missing Promoted Genes

```{r select_hypoxia_transcripts}
missing_gene_ids <- promotes$gene_id_clean[
  !promotes$gene_id_clean %in% tx_all$gene_id_clean
]
cat("Promoted genes not in feature matrix:", length(missing_gene_ids), "\n")

tx_map <- read_tsv(
  here("accessories", "human", "tx2gene_hs_dm_v49_r111.tsv.gz"),
  col_names = c("transcript_id", "gene_id"),
  col_types = "cc"
) %>%
  filter(str_starts(transcript_id, "ENST")) %>%
  transmute(
    transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", transcript_id),
    gene_id_clean       = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id)
  )

hyp_samples <- c("NM2025_0094", "NM2025_0095", "NM2025_0096")
hyp_files   <- setNames(
  file.path(here("2025_MDAcells_riboseq", "salmon"), hyp_samples, "quant.sf.gz"),
  hyp_samples
)
stopifnot("Hypoxia siCTRL quant files missing" = all(file.exists(hyp_files)))

hyp_tpm <- map_dfr(names(hyp_files), function(s) {
  read_tsv(hyp_files[[s]], col_types = "cdddd",
           col_names = c("Name", "Length", "EffectiveLength", "TPM", "NumReads"),
           skip = 1) %>%
    dplyr::select(Name, TPM) %>%
    mutate(sample = s)
}) %>%
  group_by(Name) %>%
  summarise(mean_tpm = mean(TPM), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(transcript_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", Name))

extra_tx_df <- hyp_tpm %>%
  inner_join(tx_map, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(
    gene_id_clean %in% missing_gene_ids,
    mean_tpm > 0
  ) %>%
  group_by(gene_id_clean) %>%
  slice_max(mean_tpm, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(
    promotes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_clean, symbol) %>% distinct(),
    by = "gene_id_clean"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, gene_id_clean, symbol)

n_extra         <- nrow(extra_tx_df)
n_still_missing <- length(missing_gene_ids) - n_extra
cat("Extra transcripts selected from 1hr hypoxia siCTRL:", n_extra, "\n")
cat("Genes with zero hypoxia TPM (still excluded):      ", n_still_missing, "\n")

tx_promotes <- bind_rows(tx_promotes, extra_tx_df)
cat("Promoted genes after fallback:", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")
```

# Negative Controls (Size-Matched)

```{r load_neg_controls}
neg_ctrl_pool <- read_csv(here("output", "predictive_modeling", "negative_control_genes.csv"),
                          show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id))

set.seed(9)
neg_ctrl <- neg_ctrl_pool %>% slice_sample(n = nrow(promotes))

tx_neg <- tx_all %>%
  filter(gene_id_clean %in% neg_ctrl$gene_id_clean)

cat("Negative control genes (size-matched, n =", nrow(promotes), "):", nrow(tx_neg), "\n")
```

# Luciferase Reference Sequences

```{r luciferase_sequences}
# NanoLuc -- includes stop codon TAA
nl_seq <- toupper("")
stopifnot("NanoLuc length not divisible by 3" = nchar(nl_seq) %% 3 == 0)
nl_sense <- substr(nl_seq, 1, nchar(nl_seq) - 3)  # strip stop codon for GC3

# Firefly luc2P -- the lab construct, includes stop codon TAA.
# 591 aa = luc2 (550 aa) + the same 41-aa C-terminal PEST extension carried by
# the Renilla and NanoLuc constructs below.
ff_seq <- toupper("")
stopifnot("Firefly length not divisible by 3" = nchar(ff_seq) %% 3 == 0)
ff_sense <- substr(ff_seq, 1, nchar(ff_seq) - 3)  # strip stop codon

# Renilla -- the humanized (codon-optimized) hRluc construct used in the lab,
# as supplied: ATG start retained, no stop codon, 352 codons.
#
# This is NOT the native Renilla reniformis Rluc in GenBank AF025843. The two
# encode the same enzyme (311/311 aa, a single T2A difference) but share only
# 70.8% nucleotide identity, and the codon usage is completely different:
# native GC3 = 25.7% vs humanized GC3 = 88.4%. Fetching AF025843 would put the
# Renilla reference line ~60 GC3 points too low. Do not swap this for an NCBI
# fetch. (AF025843 is doubly unsuitable: the record carries two CDS features,
# Rluc and the ampR beta-lactamase marker, so a naive FASTA parse silently
# yields a 1797 nt Rluc+ampR chimera that is still divisible by 3.)
#
# The construct is Rluc (311 aa) + a 41-aa C-terminal extension
# (NSHGFPPEVEEQAAGTLPMSCAQESGMDRHPAACASARINV), the mouse ODC PEST degron.
# All three reporters carry this same tag at their C-terminus -- Renilla
# (352 aa), Firefly luc2P (591 aa), NanoLuc (212 aa) -- but each encodes it
# with different codons (PEST GC3: Renilla 82.5%, Firefly 75.0%, NanoLuc
# 52.5%), so the tag must never be transplanted between constructs.
rl_sense <- toupper("")
stopifnot("Renilla construct is not 1056 nt (352 codons)" = nchar(rl_sense) == 1056)

# All three reporters are compared on stop-codon-free ORFs, matching the
# stop-stripped gene CDS sequences built in extract_cds_lengths below.
# rl_sense and ff_seq are already stop-free; nl_sense has its TAA removed.
cat("Reporter ORF validation:\n")
check_orf(rl_sense, "Renilla")
check_orf(ff_sense, "Firefly")
check_orf(nl_sense, "NanoLuc")

# Biological spot-check: all three lab reporters are PEST-destabilized, so each
# must end with the mouse ODC PEST degron.
PEST_AA <- "SHGFPPEVEEQAAGTLPMSCAQESGMDRHPAACASARINV"
ends_with_pest <- function(s) {
  aa <- as.character(translate(DNAString(s)))
  endsWith(aa, PEST_AA)
}
stopifnot("A reporter construct is missing its C-terminal PEST degron" =
  all(vapply(list(rl_sense, ff_sense, nl_sense), ends_with_pest, logical(1))))
cat("  All three reporters end with the ODC PEST degron\n")

# Biological spot-check: the humanized construct must encode the canonical
# Renilla luciferase N-terminus and be far more GC3-rich than the native gene.
stopifnot("Renilla construct does not encode the expected Rluc N-terminus" =
  identical(codon_split(rl_sense)[1:7],
            c("ATG", "GCT", "TCC", "AAG", "GTG", "TAC", "GAC")))  # M A S K V Y D
stopifnot("Renilla GC3 too low -- looks like the native, not humanized, gene" =
  compute_gc3_pct(rl_sense) > 70)
luc_df <- tibble(
  reporter   = c("Renilla", "Firefly", "NanoLuc"),
  cds_length = c(nchar(rl_sense), nchar(ff_sense), nchar(nl_sense)),
  gc_pct     = c(
    as.numeric(letterFrequency(DNAString(rl_sense), letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100,
    as.numeric(letterFrequency(DNAString(ff_sense), letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100,
    as.numeric(letterFrequency(DNAString(nl_sense), letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100
  ),
  gc3_pct    = c(
    compute_gc3_pct(rl_sense),
    compute_gc3_pct(ff_sense),
    compute_gc3_pct(nl_sense)
  ),
  color      = c("#CC79A7", "#009E73", "#F0E442")
)

stopifnot("Luciferase GC% out of range" =
  all(luc_df$gc_pct >= 0 & luc_df$gc_pct <= 100))
stopifnot("Luciferase GC3% out of range" =
  all(luc_df$gc3_pct >= 0 & luc_df$gc3_pct <= 100))

cat("Luciferase CDS properties (stop codon excluded):\n")
print(luc_df %>% dplyr::select(reporter, cds_length, gc_pct, gc3_pct))
```

# Extract CDS Lengths

```{r extract_cds_lengths}
txdb <- loadDb(here("accessories", "human", "txdb.gencode49.sqlite"))
cds  <- cdsBy(txdb, by = "tx", use.names = TRUE)

genome        <- BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38
cds_seqs_full <- extractTranscriptSeqs(genome, cds)
names(cds_seqs_full) <- sub("\\..*", "", names(cds_seqs_full))
stopifnot("Duplicate transcript IDs after version stripping" =
  !any(duplicated(names(cds_seqs_full))))

# GENCODE txdb CDS ranges INCLUDE the terminal stop codon (e.g. ACTB CDS =
# 1128 nt = 375 aa + stop). Strip it so gene length, GC%, and GC3% are all
# computed on the same stop-free basis as the luciferase reference sequences.
cds_seqs_full <- cds_seqs_full[
  width(cds_seqs_full) >= 3 & width(cds_seqs_full) %% 3 == 0
]

last_codon <- as.character(subseq(cds_seqs_full, start = width(cds_seqs_full) - 2L))
has_stop   <- last_codon %in% c("TAA", "TAG", "TGA")
cat("Transcripts with a terminal stop codon in the txdb CDS:",
    sum(has_stop), "of", length(has_stop),
    paste0("(", round(100 * mean(has_stop), 1), "%)\n"))

cds_seqs_nostop <- subseq(cds_seqs_full, start = 1L,
                          end = width(cds_seqs_full) - ifelse(has_stop, 3L, 0L))
cds_seqs_nostop <- cds_seqs_nostop[width(cds_seqs_nostop) > 0]

cds_len_df <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = names(cds_seqs_nostop),
  cds_length          = width(cds_seqs_nostop)
)
stopifnot("Stop-stripped CDS lengths must remain divisible by 3" =
  all(cds_len_df$cds_length %% 3 == 0))

cds_all <- tx_all %>%
  left_join(cds_len_df, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cds_length), cds_length > 0, cds_length %% 3 == 0)

cds_promotes <- tx_promotes %>%
  left_join(cds_len_df, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cds_length), cds_length > 0, cds_length %% 3 == 0)

cds_neg <- tx_neg %>%
  left_join(cds_len_df, by = "transcript_id_clean") %>%
  filter(!is.na(cds_length), cds_length > 0, cds_length %% 3 == 0)

cat("All expressed - valid CDS:", nrow(cds_all), "of", nrow(tx_all), "\n")
cat("Promoted - valid CDS:", nrow(cds_promotes), "of", nrow(tx_promotes), "\n")
cat("Negative control - valid CDS:", nrow(cds_neg), "of", nrow(tx_neg), "\n")
```

# CDS Length Distributions

```{r plot_cds_length, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
med_len_all <- median(cds_all$cds_length)
med_len_pro <- median(cds_promotes$cds_length)
cat("Median CDS length - all expressed:", med_len_all, "nt (", round(med_len_all / 1000, 2), "kb)\n")
cat("Median CDS length - promoted:     ", med_len_pro, "nt (", round(med_len_pro / 1000, 2), "kb)\n")

fmt_n <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)

p_len_all <- ggplot(cds_all, aes(x = cds_length / 1000)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "grey60", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_len_all / 1000, linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = med_len_all / 1000 + 0.5, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("median = ", round(med_len_all / 1000, 2), " kb\n",
                          "n = ", fmt_n(nrow(cds_all))),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "CDS length (kb)", y = "Number of genes",
       title = "CDS length: all expressed mRNAs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_len_pro <- ggplot(cds_promotes, aes(x = cds_length / 1000)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.5, fill = "#E69F00", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_len_pro / 1000, linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = med_len_pro / 1000 + 0.5, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("median = ", round(med_len_pro / 1000, 2), " kb\n",
                          "n = ", fmt_n(nrow(cds_promotes))),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "CDS length (kb)", y = "Number of genes",
       title = "CDS length: eIF3d hypoxia-promoted mRNAs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

print(p_len_all)
print(p_len_pro)

ggsave(here("plots", "62_cds_length_all_expressed.pdf"),      p_len_all, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(here("plots", "62_cds_length_hypoxia_promotes.pdf"),   p_len_pro, width = 6, height = 4)
```

# Extract CDS Sequences and GC Content

```{r extract_gc}
# cds_seqs_nostop was built in extract_cds_lengths: stop codon already removed,
# names already version-stripped.
cds_seq_names <- names(cds_seqs_nostop)

# GC for all expressed
keep_all <- cds_seq_names %in% cds_all$transcript_id_clean
cds_seqs_expressed <- cds_seqs_nostop[keep_all]
names(cds_seqs_expressed) <- cds_seq_names[keep_all]

gc_all <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = names(cds_seqs_expressed),
  gc_pct = as.numeric(letterFrequency(cds_seqs_expressed, letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100
)

# GC for promoted subset
keep_pro <- cds_seq_names %in% cds_promotes$transcript_id_clean
cds_seqs_promotes <- cds_seqs_nostop[keep_pro]
names(cds_seqs_promotes) <- cds_seq_names[keep_pro]

gc_promotes <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = names(cds_seqs_promotes),
  gc_pct = as.numeric(letterFrequency(cds_seqs_promotes, letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100
)

# GC for negative controls
keep_neg <- cds_seq_names %in% cds_neg$transcript_id_clean
cds_seqs_neg <- cds_seqs_nostop[keep_neg]
names(cds_seqs_neg) <- cds_seq_names[keep_neg]

gc_neg <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = names(cds_seqs_neg),
  gc_pct = as.numeric(letterFrequency(cds_seqs_neg, letters = "GC", as.prob = TRUE)) * 100
)

# Biological spot-check: ACTB CDS GC% expected 50-70%
actb_tx <- cds_all %>% filter(symbol == "ACTB") %>% pull(transcript_id_clean)
if (length(actb_tx) > 0) {
  actb_gc <- gc_all %>% filter(transcript_id_clean == actb_tx[1]) %>% pull(gc_pct)
  stopifnot("ACTB CDS GC% outside expected 50-70%" = between(actb_gc, 50, 70))
  cat("ACTB CDS GC%:", round(actb_gc, 2), "\n")
}

stopifnot("GC% out of range (all)" =
  all(gc_all$gc_pct >= 0 & gc_all$gc_pct <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot("GC% out of range (promotes)" =
  all(gc_promotes$gc_pct >= 0 & gc_promotes$gc_pct <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot("GC% out of range (neg ctrl)" =
  all(gc_neg$gc_pct >= 0 & gc_neg$gc_pct <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))

# The GC tables and the CDS-length tables must cover the same transcripts --
# medians_df reports n from cds_* alongside medians from gc_*/gc3_*.
stopifnot("GC and CDS-length transcript sets differ (all)" =
  nrow(gc_all) == nrow(cds_all))
stopifnot("GC and CDS-length transcript sets differ (promotes)" =
  nrow(gc_promotes) == nrow(cds_promotes))
stopifnot("GC and CDS-length transcript sets differ (neg ctrl)" =
  nrow(gc_neg) == nrow(cds_neg))

cat("GC computed - all expressed:", nrow(gc_all), "transcripts\n")
cat("GC computed - promoted:     ", nrow(gc_promotes), "transcripts\n")
cat("GC computed - neg control:  ", nrow(gc_neg), "transcripts\n")
```

# CDS GC Content Distributions

```{r plot_gc, fig.width=6, fig.height=4}
med_gc_all <- median(gc_all$gc_pct)
med_gc_pro <- median(gc_promotes$gc_pct)
cat("Median CDS GC% - all expressed:", round(med_gc_all, 2), "\n")
cat("Median CDS GC% - promoted:     ", round(med_gc_pro, 2), "\n")

p_gc_all <- ggplot(gc_all, aes(x = gc_pct)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "grey60", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_gc_all, linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = med_gc_all + 1, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("median = ", round(med_gc_all, 1), "%\n",
                          "n = ", fmt_n(nrow(gc_all))),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "CDS GC content (%)", y = "Number of genes",
       title = "CDS GC content: all expressed mRNAs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

p_gc_pro <- ggplot(gc_promotes, aes(x = gc_pct)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "#E69F00", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = med_gc_pro, linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = med_gc_pro + 1, y = Inf,
           label = paste0("median = ", round(med_gc_pro, 1), "%\n",
                          "n = ", fmt_n(nrow(gc_promotes))),
           hjust = 0, vjust = 1.4, size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "CDS GC content (%)", y = "Number of genes",
       title = "CDS GC content: eIF3d hypoxia-promoted mRNAs") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)

print(p_gc_all)
print(p_gc_pro)

ggsave(here("plots", "62_cds_gc_all_expressed.pdf"),     p_gc_all, width = 6, height = 4)
ggsave(here("plots", "62_cds_gc_hypoxia_promotes.pdf"),  p_gc_pro, width = 6, height = 4)
```

# GC3 Content

```{r compute_gc3}
gc3_all <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = names(cds_seqs_expressed),
  gc3_pct = sapply(as.character(cds_seqs_expressed), compute_gc3_pct, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
)

gc3_promotes <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = names(cds_seqs_promotes),
  gc3_pct = sapply(as.character(cds_seqs_promotes), compute_gc3_pct, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
)

gc3_neg <- tibble(
  transcript_id_clean = names(cds_seqs_neg),
  gc3_pct = sapply(as.character(cds_seqs_neg), compute_gc3_pct, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
)

stopifnot("GC3% out of range (all)" =
  all(gc3_all$gc3_pct >= 0 & gc3_all$gc3_pct <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot("GC3% out of range (promotes)" =
  all(gc3_promotes$gc3_pct >= 0 & gc3_promotes$gc3_pct <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot("GC3% out of range (neg ctrl)" =
  all(gc3_neg$gc3_pct >= 0 & gc3_neg$gc3_pct <= 100, na.rm = TRUE))
stopifnot("GC3 median not in expected range [40, 65]" =
  between(median(gc3_all$gc3_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 40, 65))

# Biological spot-check: ACTB GC3% expected 50-80%
if (length(actb_tx) > 0) {
  actb_gc3 <- gc3_all %>% filter(transcript_id_clean == actb_tx[1]) %>% pull(gc3_pct)
  cat("ACTB CDS GC3%:", round(actb_gc3, 2), "\n")
}

cat("Median GC3% - all expressed:", round(median(gc3_all$gc3_pct), 2), "\n")
cat("Median GC3% - promoted:     ", round(median(gc3_promotes$gc3_pct), 2), "\n")
cat("Median GC3% - neg control:  ", round(median(gc3_neg$gc3_pct), 2), "\n")
```

# Group Medians Summary

```{r group_medians}
medians_df <- tibble(
  group         = c("eIF3d promotes", "Negative control", "All expressed"),
  n             = c(nrow(cds_promotes), nrow(cds_neg), nrow(cds_all)),
  median_len_kb = c(
    round(median(cds_promotes$cds_length) / 1000, 2),
    round(median(cds_neg$cds_length) / 1000, 2),
    round(median(cds_all$cds_length) / 1000, 2)
  ),
  median_gc_pct = c(
    round(median(gc_promotes$gc_pct), 2),
    round(median(gc_neg$gc_pct), 2),
    round(median(gc_all$gc_pct), 2)
  ),
  median_gc3_pct = c(
    round(median(gc3_promotes$gc3_pct), 2),
    round(median(gc3_neg$gc3_pct), 2),
    round(median(gc3_all$gc3_pct), 2)
  )
)

print(medians_df)

write_csv(medians_df, here("output", "predictive_modeling", "62_group_medians_cds_gc.csv"))
cat("Exported: output/predictive_modeling/62_group_medians_cds_gc.csv\n")
```

# Density Plots with Luciferase Reference Lines

```{r density_setup}
group_cols <- c("All expressed"    = "grey80",
                "Negative control" = "grey40",
                "eIF3d promotes"   = "#E69F00")
luc_colors <- setNames(luc_df$color, luc_df$reporter)

# Shared density plotter for the three metrics. Handles three things that must
# be consistent across all panels:
#   1. show.legend = c(fill = TRUE, colour = FALSE) -- a bare show.legend = FALSE
#      drops the density layer from EVERY legend, including the fill legend, so
#      the three gene groups end up unlabelled while the luciferase lines keep
#      their colour legend.
#   2. per-group n in the legend labels.
#   3. Wilcoxon test, eIF3d promotes vs negative control.
plot_density_luc <- function(df, xvar, luc_var, xlab, title, outfile,
                             xscale = 1, xmax = NULL,
                             reporters = luc_df$reporter) {
  df <- df %>% mutate(.x = .data[[xvar]] / xscale)
  lev <- levels(df$group)

  luc_use <- luc_df %>% filter(reporter %in% reporters)
  stopifnot("No reporters selected for the reference lines" = nrow(luc_use) > 0)
  luc_cols_use <- setNames(luc_use$color, luc_use$reporter)

  n_tab  <- df %>% dplyr::count(group)
  labs_v <- setNames(
    sprintf("%s (n = %s)", as.character(n_tab$group), fmt_n(n_tab$n)),
    as.character(n_tab$group)
  )
  df <- df %>% mutate(group_lab = factor(labs_v[as.character(group)],
                                         levels = unname(labs_v[lev])))
  cols_lab <- setNames(unname(group_cols[lev]), unname(labs_v[lev]))

  x_pro <- df$.x[df$group == "eIF3d promotes"]
  x_neg <- df$.x[df$group == "Negative control"]
  wt    <- wilcox.test(x_pro, x_neg)
  wlab  <- sprintf("promotes vs neg ctrl\nWilcoxon p = %s\nn = %s vs %s",
                   format.pval(wt$p.value, digits = 2, eps = 2.2e-16),
                   fmt_n(length(x_pro)), fmt_n(length(x_neg)))

  luc_plot <- luc_use %>% mutate(.x = .data[[luc_var]] / xscale)

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = .x, fill = group_lab)) +
    geom_density(aes(color = group_lab), alpha = 0.15, linewidth = 0.8,
                 trim = TRUE, show.legend = c(fill = TRUE, colour = FALSE)) +
    geom_vline(data = luc_plot, aes(xintercept = .x, color = reporter),
               linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "solid") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = cols_lab, name = NULL) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(cols_lab, luc_cols_use),
                       breaks = names(luc_cols_use), name = NULL) +
    annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = wlab,
             hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.4, size = 3) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = "Density", title = title) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12)

  # coord_cartesian zooms without dropping rows, so the densities are still
  # estimated from the full data -- only the visible x range is clipped.
  if (!is.null(xmax)) {
    n_off <- sum(df$.x > xmax)
    cat(sprintf("%s: x axis clipped at %g; %s of %s transcripts (%.1f%%) fall beyond it\n",
                title, xmax, fmt_n(n_off), fmt_n(nrow(df)),
                100 * n_off / nrow(df)))
    p <- p + coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, xmax))
  }

  print(p)
  ggsave(here("plots", outfile), p, width = 7, height = 4)

  cat(title, "-- Wilcoxon promotes vs neg ctrl: p =",
      format.pval(wt$p.value, digits = 3), "\n")
  invisible(p)
}
```

```{r plot_density_length, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
len_df <- bind_rows(
  cds_all      %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, cds_length) %>%
    mutate(group = "All expressed"),
  cds_neg      %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, cds_length) %>%
    mutate(group = "Negative control"),
  cds_promotes %>% dplyr::select(transcript_id_clean, cds_length) %>%
    mutate(group = "eIF3d promotes")
) %>%
  mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("All expressed", "Negative control", "eIF3d promotes")))

p_density_len <- plot_density_luc(
  len_df, "cds_length", "cds_length",
  xlab    = "CDS length (kb)",
  title   = "CDS length distribution",
  outfile = "62_density_cds_length.pdf",
  xscale  = 1000,
  xmax    = 6
)
```

# Density Plots, Firefly and NanoLuc Only

The same three panels with the Renilla reference line dropped, for figures where
only the Firefly and NanoLuc reporters are relevant. Gene distributions, group
n, Wilcoxon tests, and the 6 kb length clip are identical to the panels above --
only the set of reference lines differs.

```{r plot_density_no_renilla, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
ff_nl <- c("Firefly", "NanoLuc")

p_density_len_ffnl <- plot_density_luc(
  len_df, "cds_length", "cds_length",
  xlab      = "CDS length (kb)",
  title     = "CDS length distribution",
  outfile   = "62_density_cds_length_ff_nl.pdf",
  xscale    = 1000,
  xmax      = 6,
  reporters = ff_nl
)

p_density_gc_ffnl <- plot_density_luc(
  gc_df, "gc_pct", "gc_pct",
  xlab      = "CDS GC content (%)",
  title     = "CDS GC content distribution",
  outfile   = "62_density_cds_gc_ff_nl.pdf",
  reporters = ff_nl
)

p_density_gc3_ffnl <- plot_density_luc(
  gc3_df, "gc3_pct", "gc3_pct",
  xlab      = "CDS GC3 content (%)",
  title     = "CDS GC3 content distribution",

)
```
